faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.subtitle: Everything you need to know about biubiu.tools. Can't find what you're looking for? Reach out to our community.

items.question: What is biubiu.tools?
items.answer: biubiu.tools is a comprehensive Web3 toolkit designed for developers, traders, and power users. It provides essential tools like token creation, batch transfers, wallet management, and contract interactions - all in one place with a clean, professional interface.

items.question: Is biubiu.tools free to use?
items.answer: Yes! Core features are completely free. For on-chain operations (like token creation or batch transfers), you only pay the network gas fees plus a small protocol fee. Alternatively, you can purchase a membership for unlimited access to all tools on your preferred chain.

items.question: Which blockchain networks are supported?
items.answer: We support 20+ EVM-compatible networks including Ethereum, BSC, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Avalanche, and many more. You can also add custom networks through our network settings.

items.question: Is my private key safe?
items.answer: Absolutely. Your private keys never leave your browser. All cryptographic operations are performed locally on your device. You can verify this yourself - our code is 100% open source.

items.question: What's the difference between Pay-Per-Use and Membership?
items.answer: Pay-Per-Use charges a small fee for each on-chain operation and doesn't include query tools. Membership gives you unlimited access to ALL tools (including premium query tools) on your purchased chain for a fixed duration. Heavy users typically save 50%+ with membership.

items.question: Do I need to connect my wallet to use the tools?
items.answer: It depends on the tool. Read-only tools (like contract explorers, unit converters, etc.) work without any connection. For on-chain operations, you'll need to either connect your wallet or import a private key - but remember, keys are processed locally only.

items.question: Is biubiu.tools open source?
items.answer: Yes! Our entire codebase is open source and available on GitHub. You can review the code, contribute improvements, or even self-host your own instance. We believe in transparency and community-driven development.

items.question: How can I get support or report issues?
items.answer: Join our Telegram group for real-time support and discussions. For bug reports and feature requests, please open an issue on our GitHub repository. We typically respond within 24 hours.
